bosses.note: Bosses: <id>_<idle|windup>_<s|e>; west = draw east with flip.

buildings.note: Buildings + Moonwell. Anchor = bottom vertex of the footprint diamond (front corner).

crops.note: Crops stand on the plot centre; soil overlay is a 32x16 diamond (anchor 16,8).

exterior.note: PHASE3-scale exteriors: bld_* (anchor front ground corner), ext_* face parts (_l SW face / _r SE face; anchor = centre of the bottom edge on the wall), roof edges, chimney, WORLD structures (bottom-centre).

furniture.note: Interior furniture. Anchor = footprint centre on the floor (foot = [tiles x, tiles y]); *_l against the left/NW back wall, *_r against the right/NE wall; hook:true = hangs from its anchor.

fx.note: Spell impact / pickup effects, centred on the impact point.

icons.note: 16x16 UI icons (topleft anchor). UI ornaments + 3-frame motes too.

interior.note: Interior floors (ifloor_<kind>_0..3) and walls (iwall_<kind>_<piece>_<l|r>, corner, end_l/r, low[door]_sw/se) per kind cottage|shop|herbal|elder|hut. Every piece anchors at the centre of the floor tile whose edge it stands on.

nature.note: Trees, bushes, rocks, fungi, reeds, crystals. Anchor = trunk/base bottom-centre.

npcs.note: Villagers in the witch 48x56 cell, foot (24,49): npc_<marrow|pip|wren>_<idle|talk>_<s|e|n>; west = e flipped. cat_idle_<s|e>.

props.note: Placeable props. Anchor = bottom-centre ground point. Fences anchor at the segment midpoint.

tiles.note: 32x16 iso diamonds, anchor = diamond centre (16,8). Side skirts anchor at their top vertex.
